'''Eefive-Tootoo''' was an [[E522 assassin droid/Legends|E522 assassin droid]]. Originally in the service of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], Eefive was fed to the [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|rancor]]. Two [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] salvaged the remains, stripped the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] of its [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] programming and sold the unit to [[Valarian/Legends|Lady Valarian]]. 

==History==
Eefive-Tootoo was acquired by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. While on the [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]] ''[[Khetanna/Legends|Khetanna]]'', one of Jabba's [[Human/Legends|Human]] servants accused the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Doikk Na'ts/Legends|Doikk Na'ts]] of snacking on Jabba's stash of [[freckled toad]]s. Eefive was present and provided Jabba with an alibi for Doikk's whereabouts. Disappointed at having no one to truly blame, Jabba decided to take his frustration out on Eefive. He had him liberally coated with meat juices and thrown into the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] dungeon at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. By the time the rancor had finished with Eefive, the remains were seemingly beyond repair.<ref name="WDDW" />

Some time after this event, two [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], [[Het Nkik/Legends|Het Nkik]] and [[Jek Nkik]] found Eefive's discarded remains. After [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of rebuilding the droid, they successfully sold the unit, stripped of its weapons systems, to the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] gangster known as Lady [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]] who put him to use as her personal messenger.<ref name="SM">{{StoryCite|story=Swap Meet: The Jawa's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>

Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Valarian sent Eefive to Jabba's Palace to recruit the Bith musical group [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]] to perform at her wedding to the Whiphid hunter [[D'Wopp]]. Eefive tendered an offer of three thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to the band for one night's work.<ref name="WDDW" />
